pageTitle: STEP Past Papers, Extended Solutions & Grade Boundaries | Arij Asad
description: STEP papers from 1987, earlier specimens, extended worked solutions and grade boundaries by year. Includes historical STEP 1 and current STEP 2 and STEP 3.
intro: Choose a year, open the paper and work through the solutions alongside its grade boundaries. Explore STEP 2 and STEP 3, the historical STEP 1 archive and free preparation resources.
displayNotes: STEP 2 and STEP 3 are the current papers. STEP 1 was last sat in 2019 and was cancelled in 2020. Older papers use historical syllabuses and formats.
Boundaries are the minimum marks for grades S, 1, 2 and 3, out of 120. Use the boundaries for the exact year and paper. N/A means unavailable or not applicable.

Extended solutions appear first where available. Community discussions may be incomplete; specific gaps are noted below. MEI provides worked solutions through the guest access described on its website.

linkSections.title: Cambridge STEP Support Programme
linkSections.description: Free preparation modules with hints, topic notes and full solutions, progressing from Foundation work to STEP 2 and STEP 3.
linkSections.credit: University of Cambridge Faculty of Mathematics and Millennium Mathematics Project

linkSections.title: Cambridge worked STEP papers
linkSections.description: Detailed worked solutions and commentary for STEP 2 and 3, 2019–2025, useful when reviewing timed practice.
linkSections.credit: University of Cambridge STEP Support Programme

linkSections.title: STEP Question Database
linkSections.description: Search individual questions by topic and paper, covering the 1986 specimen papers through 2018.

linkSections.title: Advanced Problems in Mathematics
linkSections.description: Stephen Siklos's free 2019 second edition offers selected STEP problems, strategic commentary and full solutions. Cambridge recommends this publisher edition of the revised and extended earlier booklets.

linkSections.title: Underground Mathematics STEP solutions
linkSections.description: Selected STEP questions with detailed explanations and worked solutions, organised within a broader mathematics resource collection.

linkSections.title: Mathsaurus written STEP solutions
linkSections.description: Independent typed worked solutions: STEP I, II and III for 2016–2019, plus STEP II and III for 2020. The author states that these are not official mark schemes.
linkSections.credit: Anonymous Cambridge mathematics graduate and former STEP marker; hosted by Mathsaurus

linkSections.title: Mathsaurus STEP video solutions
linkSections.description: Worked videos for selected questions from STEP I, II and III; the source page indexes the individual questions covered.

linkSections.title: The Student Room community solutions
linkSections.description: Year-by-year discussions contain contributors' solutions and alternative approaches to older STEP papers. Coverage varies; opening posts sometimes identify missing or incomplete answers.
linkSections.credit: The Student Room mathematics contributors, including SimonM, DFranklin, brianeverit, nota bene, Speleo and others credited at each solution

linkSections.title: Cambridge STEP information
linkSections.description: The Faculty's official overview explains current paper structure and links preparation materials and exam-board information. Older questions may cover material outside today's specification.
linkSections.credit: University of Cambridge Faculty of Mathematics
